title: Tagging round skill
summary: Adds the /grillo-tagging skill that labels every open ticket with the members' declared domains or domain:none, protecting hand-set tags with a tags-by-hand marker comment; 30 new tests.
lessons_learned: CI did not run (no GitHub Actions minutes on the account); by the user's word the merge was gated on the local Windows gate only, so nothing has checked these merges on Mac until CI minutes return

deferred.what: updateTicket sets domain labels when a member changes tags by hand on the ticket screen but writes no <!-- grillo:tags-by-hand --> marker, so the next tagging round silently replaces the member's hand-set tags
deferred.why: Outside the tagging skill's seam (store, and issue #82's renderer-only screen); who writes the marker is a design choice
